name: progettai-commerce
description: Discover ProgettAI business projects and shop their catalogs and carts through natural conversation. Learn more and set up: https://progettai.ai/crew
author: progettai

keyFile.title: Signing key file
keyFile.description: Absolute path to the ECDSA P-256 private key file you downloaded from the ProgettAI console (PKCS#8 PEM, starts with -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----). Use it as-is; no conversion is needed. The key never leaves this machine, and the console cannot re-issue it — keep a backup.

keyId.title: Key ID
keyId.description: The Key ID shown next to that key in your ProgettAI account settings, copied verbatim. It must be the key your project currently has selected — if you rotate keys, update this and the key file together.

bridgeUrl.title: Bridge URL
bridgeUrl.description: MCP Bridge endpoint. Must match the bridge's own public URL exactly, including scheme and path.

profileUrl.title: UCP profile URL (advanced)
profileUrl.description: Override only if you host your UCP client profile outside ProgettAI. Defaults to https://<bridge-origin>/projects/<projectId>/.well-known/ucp-client.

frontendUrl.title: Frontend URL (advanced)
frontendUrl.description: ProgettAI web app origin used to build the authenticated cart page link (<frontendUrl>/cart) that the bridge gives you after a Shopify cart is created. Must be an HTTPS origin: no username or password, no path other than an optional trailing slash, and no query or fragment. The value is normalized to its origin, so a trailing slash and an explicit :443 are dropped while a non-default port is kept. Defaults to https://progettai.ai. Read once at startup, so a change takes effect on the next restart.

logLevel.title: Log level
logLevel.description: Logs go to stderr and never include key material or request bodies.

imageMode.title: Card image mode
imageMode.description: How catalog product-card images are resolved in the 'widget' render mode. 'remote' (default) points each card's at the business CDN directly under the declared image resource domains, so the browser fetches the image itself — this discloses the ucp-client's IP address and user agent to the business CDN. 'inline' has the bridge fetch each image server-side and embed a small card-sized data: copy, so nothing is disclosed to the business CDN but every image passes through the bridge. 'off' emits no and renders the monogram placeholder on every card. Read once at startup, so a change takes effect on the next restart.

imageResourceDomains.title: Image resource domains
imageResourceDomains.description: Allowlist of business CDN origins the 'remote' image mode may load card images from, advertised as the widget's CSP resource domains. Each entry uses the shape https://[*.]host[:port] — an https origin, an optional leading *. wildcard for one subdomain level, and an optional port (for example https://cdn.example.com or https://*.images.example.com:8443). Required and must be non-empty when imageMode is 'remote'; otherwise every card renders as a placeholder. Ignored by the 'inline' and 'off' modes. Read once at startup, so a change takes effect on the next restart.

imageFetchTimeoutMs.title: Image fetch timeout (ms)
imageFetchTimeoutMs.description: Wall-clock timeout for fetching a single product image. A slower source is abandoned and the card falls back to the placeholder. Must be a positive number.

imageFetchMaxBytes.title: Image fetch max bytes
imageFetchMaxBytes.description: Maximum response size, in bytes, read for a single product image fetch. A larger source is abandoned and the card falls back to the placeholder. Must be a positive number.

imageCardMaxEdgePx.title: Card image max edge (px)
imageCardMaxEdgePx.description: Maximum edge length, in pixels, of the card-sized image derived for each catalog card. Matches the catalog card image box height ceiling. Must be a positive number.

imageCardMaxBytes.title: Card image max bytes
imageCardMaxBytes.description: Per-card size ceiling, in bytes, for the derived card image so the assembled widget stays within budget. A card image that cannot meet this budget falls back to the placeholder. Must be a positive number.

imageMaxPerInvocation.title: Max images per invocation
imageMaxPerInvocation.description: Maximum number of product images resolved per catalog search. Cards beyond this cap fall back to the placeholder so a search with many uncached images does not extend the tool call unboundedly. Must be a positive number.

a2aStreaming.title: A2A streaming delivery
a2aStreaming.description: Request incremental A2A message/stream delivery from businesses that support it; falls back to buffered message/send automatically. Default on. Read once at startup, so a change takes effect on the next restart.
